subject: SIG deliverables & portal-naming convention for Acme procurement
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecorp.com>
Cc: rafael.mendes@redwood.com, sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: SIG deliverables & portal-naming convention for Acme procurement

Samantha —

Thanks for the heads up on the procurement timeline. We're assembling the SIG package for Acme and want to make sure the deliverables land in the exact format your procurement team expects to avoid back-and-forth. A few confirmations would help: 

- Preferred upload target: Whistic portal (link?) vs OneTrust SFTP. You mentioned both in the RFP.
- File-level requirements: PDF export of the completed SIG questionnaire (single PDF, bookmarked by section) + a separate evidence bundle (zip). Does Acme require password-protected ZIPs? If so, what password convention should we use?
- Naming convention: do you expect something like ACME_SIG_YYYYMMDD_CompanyName.pdf or a specific token in the filename?
- Evidence manifest: would you like a CSV mapping (control id -> filename -> description)? We can produce one with the export.

We plan to include a redacted SOC 2 summary (no product logs) and the full SIG export (with answer notes). Rafael will prepare the PDF export and the evidence manifest; Sofia will do portal uploads. Can you confirm: final handoff deadline is EOD 2026-09-23 PST, and procurement will accept uploads + a DocuSign form?

Attachments: instruction checklist stub included below.

Thanks — Marissa

[Attachment: SIG_packaging_checklist.txt (TXT, 12KB)]

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG deliverables & portal-naming convention for Acme procurement

Marissa —

Great — thanks for being proactive. Answers inline: 

- Upload target: Whistic is preferred for questionnaire records (use the portal entry we shared). OneTrust is acceptable for larger evidence bundles if you need SFTP (but we prefer Whistic for the primary SIG PDF so our vendor portal links to it). 
- Files: Please provide: 1) SIG Export (single, flattened PDF, with section bookmarks), 2) Evidence bundle (ZIP), 3) Evidence manifest (CSV).
- ZIP policy: Password-protected ZIPs are required for evidence bundles. Use the convention: AcmeSIG_<VendorShort>_<YYYYMMDD>.zip and send the password to procurement@acmecorp.com in a separate email (do not include password in portal notes).
- Filename example we prefer: ACME_SIG_REDWOOD_20260921.pdf for the SIG export; evidence manifest: ACME_SIG_EVIDENCE_REDWOOD_20260921.csv
- Metadata: When you upload to Whistic, set the record title to "Acme - Redwood SIG 2026-09-21" and add tags: procurement, sigma-2026, redwood.

Yes, EOD 2026-09-23 PST is the deadline. Procurement will also require a DocuSign confirmation for vendor security attestation; they'll send a PowerForm link after the portal record is visible.

Please also include a one-page redacted SOC 2 summary (PDF) that lists scope and audit date but no internal log extracts. That summary can be bundled with the PDF export or uploaded as a separate file — whichever is easier for your team.

Samantha
Procurement Operations — Acme Corp
Samantha.Lee@acmecorp.com

[Portal reference: https://acmecorp.whistic.io/records/89f3-portal-entry]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com, sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SIG deliverables & portal-naming convention for Acme procurement

Team — forwarding Samantha's confirmations. Action items: 

1) Rafael: produce the flattened, bookmarked PDF export of the completed SIG. Filename per procurement: ACME_SIG_REDWOOD_20260921.pdf. Also create the redacted SOC2 summary PDF (redacted_SOC2_summary.pdf). Ensure internal-only notes are removed.
2) Rafael: produce evidence_manifest_acme.csv — columns: control_id, control_desc, answer_ref, filename, redaction_notes.
3) Sofia: prepare the evidence bundle ZIP, password-protected, named AcmeSIG_REDWOOD_20260921.zip. Upload the SIG PDF to Whistic first and set the record title/tags as Samantha specified. Then upload the ZIP to OneTrust SFTP if Whistic can't handle large binaries; otherwise attach ZIP to the Whistic record. Send password to procurement@acmecorp.com in a separate email once the record is live.

I attached the internal packaging checklist and a sample manifest template. Can you confirm ETA for the artifacts? We should target a dry run upload by EOD 2026-09-22 so we can fix any portal metadata issues before the procurement deadline.

Thanks — Marissa

[Attachment: packaging_manifest_template.csv (CSV, 4KB)]
